limitations: Scientific and numerical presentation crosscheck, not human peer review or physical-origin validation.
Twenty-four ordered nonself rows per frame/region reuse seven observations, with eighteen unordered pair relationships and six reciprocal duplicates; per-reference identities remain explicit.
Fixed common core differs from original member cores by 0.0025 Angstrom at one edge; original intervals fit the full spectral context and raw crops remain separately preserved.
All positive measured source samples and false low flags do not supply calibrated uncertainty or sensitivity; positive ERR support is absent.
Four group-center predictions and two original discovery markers lie outside fixed topocentric common core, without full finite-feature support claims or recentering.
Bright raw edge bands dominate full scales; faint central structure is retained without new variants or origin claims.
Next C015 requires its own wavelength-specific freeze; completed normalization routes and current joint members are not replayed.
